ng-add.description: Adds an Angular Native app to this workspace, with its dependencies installed.

application.description: An Angular Native app: an Expo project in the workspace, registered in angular.json.

component.description: A component for an Angular Native app, with native elements and a test that runs in Node.

desktop.description: Adds macOS and Linux to an Angular Native app: @ng-native/desktop, macos and linux in expo.platforms with Expo's out-of-tree platforms flag, the config plugin, and macos, linux and package targets.

mobile.description: Adds iOS and Android to a desktop-only Angular Native app: ios and android in expo.platforms with the phone settings, expo-status-bar and expo-system-ui, and run-ios and run-android targets.
